template.title: The Grumpy Garden Friend
template.summary: A curious child discovers a grumpy garden creature is sad because it lost its glasses, and a small gift turns the grump into a friend.

sentences.text_with_blanks: [[slot_child]] peeked through the backyard fence and heard a [[slot_noise]] from the garden.
The noise sounded like a big growl, and [[slot_child]] felt a little curious.
Instead of running away, [[slot_child]] crept closer to the garden gate.
In the garden, [[slot_creature]] was stuck on a low branch, its eyes squinting.
[[slot_creature]] looked grumpy because it had lost its reading glasses, which made it feel sad.
[[slot_child]] remembered the [[slot_gift]] in its pocket and offered it to [[slot_creature]].
The [[slot_creature]] put on the glasses and instantly smiled, looking bright and happy.
[[slot_creature]] thanked [[slot_child]] and shared a quiet moment under the oak tree.
They both watched the clouds drift by, feeling warm and friendly.
When the sun set, [[slot_child]] waved goodbye, knowing a new friendship had grown.
